title: Credit Risk Note: Exposure Points on a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Arrears Payment by Months to Maturity
content:
**Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract — longer remaining exposure on an arrears payment taken toward an extension.**

**Rule.** The months to maturity are the whole calendar months from today to the contract's maturity date. When the months to maturity are at least 36 and the contract is on Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 4 or Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5, 5 percentage points are added to the arrears share; when the months to maturity are at least 36 on any other tier, 2.5 points are added; in every other case no points are added.

The points are added to the arrears share that applies to the contract, which is then applied once to the other past-due amount.

**Counting.** Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment.

## Points by tier and months to maturity

| Tier | Months to maturity 36 or more | Fewer than 36 |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5 | 5 points added | none |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 4 | 5 points added | none |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 3 | 2.5 points added | none |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 2 | 2.5 points added | none |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1 | 2.5 points added | none |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1+ | 2.5 points added | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Today the 10th of a month; maturity on the 10th of the month 36 months later: 36 whole months, so the points apply. Maturity on the 9th of that month: 35 whole months, so none.
- A Tier 4 contract 40 months from maturity: 5 points; a Tier 2 contract 40 months from maturity: 2.5 points.
